Case :- Criminal Misc Anticipatory Bail Application U/S 438 Cr.P.C. No. - 11691 of 2023

Applicant :- Smt. Jareena And Another
Opposite Party :- State Of U.P. And 3 Others
Counsel for Applicant :- A.C.Tiwari(Ac),Shyam Kishore Tripathi

Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.,Rafeek Ahmad Khan
Hon'ble Krishan Pahal,J.
1.
List has been revised.
Supplementary affidavit filed today by learned counsel for the applicants is taken on record.

2. Heard Sri A.C. Tiwari, learned counsel for the applicants, Sri S.P. Pandey, learned A.G.A. for the State and perused the material placed on record.
3.

The instant application has been filed with a prayer to enlarge them onanticipatory bail in Case Crime No.57 of 2023, under Sections- 498A, 304B I.P.C. and Sections- 3/4 of Dowry Prohibition Act, Police Station- Kharela, District- Mahoba, during the pendency of trial.

Smt. Jareena And Another vs State Of U.P. And 3 Others on 17 November, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/140281083/

entities.text: Smt. Jareena And Another vs State Of U.P. And 3 Others
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Learned counsel for the applicants has submitted that co-accused person, Hasan, has already been granted anticipatory bail by Co-ordinate Bench of this Court vide order dated 27.10.2023 passed in Criminal Misc. Anticipatory Bail Application U/S 438 Cr.P.C. No.11702 of 2023.
Therefore, the present applicants, who are mother-in-law and father-in-law of the deceased, are also entitled for anticipatory bail on the ground of parity.
Learned counsel for the applicants undertakes that they will cooperate in the trial, failing which the State can move appropriate application for cancellation of the anticipatory bail.
5. The prayer for anticipatory bail has been vehemently opposed by learned A.G.A.
However, the aforesaid factual aspect of the parity to the co-accused has not been disputed by him.

6. Considering the facts and circumstances of the case, submissions made by learned counsel for the parties, the evidence on record, pending trial and in light of the judgement passed by this Court in Nanha S/o Nabhan Kha vs. State of U.P., 1993 Crl.L.J. 938 and the judgement passed by the Apex Court in Paras Ram Vishnoi vs. The Director, Central Bureau of Investigation,
MANU/SCOR/22410/2021, without expressing any opinion on the merits of the case, the Court is of the view that the applicants have made out a case for anticipatory bail.

Paras Ram Vishnoi vs. The Director, Central Bureau of Investigation,
MANU/SCOR/22410/2021
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: The anticipatory bail application is allowed on the ground of parity.
7. In view of the above, the anticipatory bail application of the applicants is allowed.
